title_en: How to get a copy of your divorce record in {state}
title_es: Cómo obtener una copia de su registro de divorcio en {state_es}

facts.claim_en: The CDC lists $15.00 as the cost of a divorce record copy from the Alabama Center for Health Statistics.
facts.claim_es: Según los CDC, una copia de un registro de divorcio del Centro de Estadísticas de Salud de Alabama cuesta $15.00.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Cost of copy: $15.00

facts.claim_en: Alabama's state office has divorce records since January 1950.
facts.claim_es: La oficina estatal de Alabama tiene registros de divorcio desde enero de 1950.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: State office has records since January 1950.

facts.claim_en: Alabama divorce records are not restricted, but the state office does not provide divorce decrees.
facts.claim_es: Los registros de divorcio de Alabama no son restringidos, pero la oficina estatal no entrega sentencias de divorcio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Divorce records are not restricted.

facts.claim_en: Extra copies of the same record ordered at the same time cost $6.00 each.
facts.claim_es: Las copias adicionales del mismo registro pedidas al mismo tiempo cuestan $6.00 cada una.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Additional copies of the same record ordered at the same time are $6.00 each.

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Alabama
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Alabama

facts.claim_en: The CDC lists $30.00 as the cost of a divorce record copy from Alaska's state vital records office.
facts.claim_es: Según los CDC, una copia de un registro de divorcio de la oficina estatal de registros vitales de Alaska cuesta $30.00.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Cost of copy: $30.00

facts.claim_en: Alaska's state office has divorce records since 1950.
facts.claim_es: La oficina estatal de Alaska tiene registros de divorcio desde 1950.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: State office has records since 1950.

facts.claim_en: Extra copies of the same record ordered at the same time cost $25.00.
facts.claim_es: Las copias adicionales del mismo registro pedidas al mismo tiempo cuestan $25.00.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Additional copies of the same record ordered at the same time are $25.00.

facts.claim_en: Every request must include a copy of the applicant's picture ID.
facts.claim_es: Toda solicitud debe incluir una copia de la identificación con foto del solicitante.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: ALL REQUESTS MUST INCLUDE A COPY OF A PICTURE ID OF THE APPLICANT.

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Alaska
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Alaska

facts.claim_en: The CDC lists $20 as the cost of a divorce record copy in Arizona.
facts.claim_es: Según los CDC, una copia de un registro de divorcio en Arizona cuesta $20.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Cost of copy: $20

facts.claim_en: Arizona divorce records are kept by the Clerk of Superior Court in the county where the divorce was granted.
facts.claim_es: En Arizona, los registros de divorcio los guarda el Secretario del Tribunal Superior del condado donde se otorgó el divorcio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Clerk of Superior Court in county where divorce was granted.

facts.claim_en: In Mohave County, the public can get copies of divorce decrees from the Clerk of the Superior Court.
facts.claim_es: En el condado de Mohave, el público puede obtener copias de sentencias de divorcio del Secretario del Tribunal Superior.
facts.source_name: Mohave County Superior Court: Clerk of the Superior Court
facts.quote: domestic relations/family court (divorce decrees)

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Arizona
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Arizona

facts.claim_en: The CDC lists $10.00 as the cost of a divorce record copy from the Arkansas Department of Health.
facts.claim_es: Según los CDC, una copia de un registro de divorcio del Departamento de Salud de Arkansas cuesta $10.00.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Cost of copy: $10.00

facts.claim_en: Arkansas's state office has divorce coupons (records) since 1923.
facts.claim_es: La oficina estatal de Arkansas tiene cupones (registros) de divorcio desde 1923.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: State office has coupons since 1923.

facts.claim_en: Extra copies of the same divorce record requested at the same time cost $10.00 each.
facts.claim_es: Las copias adicionales del mismo registro de divorcio pedidas al mismo tiempo cuestan $10.00 cada una.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Additional copies of the same divorce record, when requested at the same time, are $10.00 each.

facts.claim_en: A photo ID of the person requesting the certificate is required.
facts.claim_es: Se requiere una identificación con foto de la persona que solicita el certificado.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: A photo ID of the person requesting the certificate is required

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Arkansas
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Arkansas

facts.claim_en: The CDC lists $14.00 for a California divorce Certificate of Record from the state Department of Public Health.
facts.claim_es: Según los CDC, un Certificado de Registro de divorcio del Departamento de Salud Pública de California cuesta $14.00.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Cost of copy: $14.00

facts.claim_en: A California Certificate of Record is not a certified copy of the divorce decree and does not show whether the divorce was finalized.
facts.claim_es: En California, el Certificado de Registro no es una copia certificada de la sentencia de divorcio y no indica si el divorcio se finalizó.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: It is not a certified copy of the divorce decree and does not indicate whether the divorce was ever finalized in court.

facts.claim_en: The state office only has information for divorces filed between 1962 and June 1984.
facts.claim_es: La oficina estatal solo tiene información de divorcios presentados entre 1962 y junio de 1984.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: only has information for divorces that were filed with the court between 1962 and June, 1984

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in California
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en California

facts.claim_en: Colorado's state health department does not issue certified copies of divorce records.
facts.claim_es: El departamento de salud estatal de Colorado no emite copias certificadas de registros de divorcio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Certified copies are not available from State Health Department.

facts.claim_en: The state fee for an index verification of a Colorado divorce is $17.00.
facts.claim_es: La tarifa estatal para verificar un divorcio en el índice de Colorado es de $17.00.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Fee for index verification is $17.00.

facts.claim_en: Copies come from the Clerk of District Court in the county where the divorce was granted.
facts.claim_es: Las copias se obtienen del Secretario del Tribunal de Distrito del condado donde se otorgó el divorcio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Copies available from Clerk of District Court in county where divorce was granted.

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Colorado
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Colorado

facts.claim_en: For a copy, contact the Clerk of Superior Court where the dissolution of marriage was granted.
facts.claim_es: Para obtener una copia, comuníquese con el Secretario del Tribunal Superior donde se otorgó la disolución del matrimonio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Applicant must contact Clerk of Superior Court where the dissolution of marriage/civil union was granted.

facts.claim_en: Connecticut's State Office of Vital Records does not record dissolution decrees and cannot issue certified copies.
facts.claim_es: La Oficina Estatal de Registros Vitales de Connecticut no registra sentencias de disolución y no puede emitir copias certificadas.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: The State Office of Vital Records does not record dissolution decrees and cannot issue certified copies.

facts.claim_en: Connecticut's Vital Records Office does not keep copies of divorce decrees.
facts.claim_es: La Oficina de Registros Vitales de Connecticut no guarda copias de sentencias de divorcio.
facts.source_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health: Vital Records
facts.quote: The Vital Records Office does not maintain copies of divorce decrees.

facts.claim_en: To get a copy of a divorce decree, contact the CT Superior Court where the divorce was granted.
facts.claim_es: Para obtener una copia de la sentencia de divorcio, comuníquese con el Tribunal Superior de Connecticut donde se otorgó el divorcio.
facts.source_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health: Vital Records
facts.quote: contact the CT Superior Court where the divorce or dissolution was granted

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Connecticut
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Connecticut

facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: For divorces granted after 1975, the parties concerned should contact Family Court in county where divorce was granted.

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Delaware
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Delaware

facts.claim_en: Records from before September 16, 1956 are with the Clerk of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia.

facts.claim_en: Florida divorce certificates from June 6, 1927 to the present are available from the Department of Health's Bureau of Vital Statistics.
facts.claim_es: Los certificados de divorcio de Florida desde el 6 de junio de 1927 hasta hoy están disponibles en la Oficina de Estadísticas Vitales del Departamento de Salud.
facts.source_name: Florida Department of Health: Divorce or Annulment Certificates
facts.quote: Florida dissolution of marriage certificates from June 6, 1927 to present that have been recorded by the clerk of court are available through the Florida Department of Health’s Bureau of Vital Statistics.

facts.claim_en: The certificate is an abstract of the judgment and is accepted as evidence that the divorce was finalized.
facts.claim_es: El certificado es un resumen de la sentencia y se acepta como prueba de que el divorcio se finalizó.
facts.source_name: Florida Department of Health: Divorce or Annulment Certificates
facts.quote: The certificate is issued as an abstract of the information taken from the judgment and is acceptable as evidence that a dissolution was finalized and granted.

facts.claim_en: The full divorce judgment comes from the clerk of court in the county where the divorce was granted.
facts.claim_es: La sentencia completa de divorcio se obtiene del secretario del tribunal del condado donde se otorgó el divorcio.
facts.source_name: Florida Department of Health: Divorce or Annulment Certificates
facts.quote: The actual judgment may be obtained from the clerk of court in the county where the dissolution was granted.

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Florida
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Florida

facts.claim_en: Georgia's state office issues a $10.00 verification letter that confirms the date and county of a divorce.
facts.claim_es: La oficina estatal de Georgia emite una carta de verificación de $10.00 que confirma la fecha y el condado del divorcio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: $10.00 for verification letter which verifies date and county of divorce.

facts.claim_en: The State Office of Vital Records can confirm Georgia divorces from June 1952 to August 1996.
facts.claim_es: La Oficina Estatal de Registros Vitales puede confirmar divorcios en Georgia de junio de 1952 a agosto de 1996.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: The State Office of Vital Records can search and confirm divorces that have taken place in the state of Georgia from June 1952 to August 1996.

facts.claim_en: For divorces before 1952 or after 1996, go to the Clerk of Superior Court in the county where the divorce was granted.
facts.claim_es: Para divorcios antes de 1952 o después de 1996, acuda al Secretario del Tribunal Superior del condado donde se otorgó el divorcio.
facts.source_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: Where to Write for Vital Records
facts.quote: Verifications prior to 1952 and after 1996 are only available from the Clerk of Superior Court in the county where the divorce was granted.

official_links.label_en: CDC: where to write for vital records in Georgia
official_links.label_es: CDC: dónde solicitar registros vitales en Georgia

facts.claim_en: A verification includes names, dates of birth, date of the event and city or county.
facts.claim_es: Una verificación incluye nombres, fechas de nacimiento, fecha del evento y ciudad o condado.
facts.source_name: Illinois Department of Public Health: Dissolution of Marriage Records
facts.quote: The facts of a dissolution of marriage include: names, dates of birth, date of event and city/county of event.
